_comment: Where each district's ADOPTED policy manual actually lives. Discovered 2026-08-20 from each district's BoardDocs /Public config (bd.policy_url / bd.policy_connected) and, for port-chester-rye, from its own /board/policies page. Every district here is on the NYSSBA policy service, but the manual is served by one of two third-party portals — NOT by BoardDocs (whose BD-GetPolicies API returns 'No Access' anonymously) and NOT by the district website (which links only a handful of loose PDFs). 'discover_from' is a district page known to link the portal, for districts whose portal URL we haven't pinned yet; the probe follows it.

boardpolicyonline.note: Legacy ?b=<slug> redirects to v3.boardpolicyonline.com/b/<slug>. Section deep links use &s=<section_id>.

microscribe.note: Folio infobase served through om_isapi.dll; depth/softpage params drive the tree.
